definitions.explanation: The grammatical rules and structures of the English language. A common subject in Japanese education from junior high school onward.

examples.japanese: {英文法|えいぶんぽう}が{苦手|にがて}だ。
{英文法|えいぶんぽう}の{参考書|さんこうしょ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought an English grammar reference book.

examples.japanese: {英文法|えいぶんぽう}をしっかり{学|まな}んでから、{英会話|えいかいわ}の{練習|れんしゅう}に{取|と}り{組|く}んだ。
examples.english: After studying English grammar thoroughly, I worked on practicing English conversation.

notes:
USAGE:
Formed from {英|えい} (English) + {文法|ぶんぽう} (grammar). A standard compound in the Japanese education system. The ～{文法|ぶんぽう} pattern is productive: {日本語|にほんご}{文法|ぶんぽう} (Japanese grammar), {仏|ふつ}{文法|ぶんぽう} (French grammar), etc.

RELATED TERMS:
- {英語|えいご}: English (language)
- {英会話|えいかいわ}: English conversation
- {英作文|えいさくぶん}: English composition
- {文法|ぶんぽう}: grammar (general)
